project: 楚氏春秋·开局围宫 (v2 电影级汉代重构)

style_guidelines.era: 正统汉代/三国蜀汉 (Authentic Three Kingdoms Han Dynasty)
style_guidelines.forbid_styles: 严禁日本战国、武士刀、和服、乌帽子、阵羽织、动漫卡通、恐怖怪脸
style_guidelines.color_palette: 玄黑、朱红、明黄金丝、古铜暖光、暴雨冷青 (High saturation cinematic historical drama)

LiuShan.name: 刘禅 (Liu Shan)
LiuShan.visual_anchor: 28-year-old handsome Chinese emperor, wearing authentic Han Dynasty imperial ceremonial Xuan-Yi (玄衣纁裳，交领右衽黑色丝绸锦袍配朱红边缘与汉代金龙暗纹), wearing Han imperial Tongtian Guan (汉代通天冠) with jade hairpin, clean-shaven or neat trimmed goatee, sharp determined eyes, regal aura, zero anime, zero samurai.

ZhugeLiang.name: 诸葛亮 (Zhuge Liang)
ZhugeLiang.visual_anchor: 54-year-old dignified Chinese scholar-statesman, refined intellectual face with neat long black and gray beard (三缕美髯), wearing traditional Chinese Han scholar robe (汉代交领大袖深衣青黑儒服), wearing authentic Chinese Jinxian Guan (进贤冠文官礼冠), holding a classic Chinese white crane feather fan (正统白鹅毛扇). Wise, solemn, profound sorrow, zero Japanese kimono, zero eboshi.

Eunuch.name: 内侍 (Palace Eunuch)
Eunuch.visual_anchor: 20-year-old young Chinese court eunuch, wearing Han Dynasty azure blue servant Hanfu (汉代交领青衣内侍服), wearing a simple black cloth cap (小冠帻), terrified expression, stumbled on crimson carpet.

NobleLady.name: 世家女子 (Noble Lady Warrior)
NobleLady.visual_anchor: 22-year-old fierce noble Chinese female warrior, wearing dark crimson Hanfu martial dress (汉代交领窄袖武士劲装), high Chinese hair bun with bronze hairpin, drawing a straight double-edged Chinese Han Jian (八面汉剑，直刃，严禁日本武士弯刀).

shots.speaker: 【内侍】
shots.title: 太监仓皇跪报
shots.prompt: A cinematic medium shot inside an authentic Han dynasty imperial palace study. In the center on the crimson carpet, a panicked 20-year-old young Chinese court servant wearing azure blue Hanfu court servant robe stumbles to his knees, pointing trembling hands toward the palace doors. Bronze incense burner on carved dark wood table emitting swirls of smoke. Warm flickering candlelight, storm lightning flashing through wooden latticed windows in background, masterpiece, 8k, photorealistic Chinese historical drama, authentic Han Dynasty.
